question: An autopsy is being performed on an elderly man who died from a myocardial infarction. Biopsy of the heart is likely to reveal necrosis most similar to necrosis seen in which of the following scenarios?

options.opa: The central nervous system following a stroke
options.opb: The lung following a tuberculosis infection
options.opc: Acute pancreatitis resulting from release of enzymatically active enzymes into the pancreas
options.opd: A region of kidney where blood flow is obstructed

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Myocardial infarction -> ischemic injury to the heart tissue -> necrosis in the heart muscle -> 80% CHAIN: Necrosis in the heart muscle -> coagulative necrosis -> similar to necrosis seen in a region of the kidney where blood flow is obstructed -> 75% CHAIN: Myocardial infarction -> ischemic injury to the heart tissue -> necrosis in the heart muscle -> similar to necrosis seen in acute pancreatitis due to enzymatic activity -> 80%
analysis: Myocardial infarction results in necrosis of heart tissue due to lack of blood supply. The most similar scenario in terms of necrosis would be seen in a region of the kidney where blood flow is obstructed, leading to ischemic necrosis.
